title: The Lord's Promise of Zion's Restoration
description: The prophet declares that he will not remain silent until Zion's righteousness shines forth, and describes God's love for the people through the imagery of a bride. Watchmen on the walls call out to the Lord until the city is restored, and the Lord swears that the people shall enjoy the fruit of their labor. Finally, it is announced that the Savior comes with reward and recompense before him, and the people receive new honorable names.
